family: PuentePrefa precast bridge beams (Viga California I, Simple te)

source.title: Elementos prefabricados (web page)
source.page_text: Las vigas prefabricadas permiten construir tramos con longitudes entre los 4m y los 40m. Estas se refuerzan con pretensión o con postensión según se requiera. Resistencia del concreto 245–700 kg/cm2.

geometry_notes: Viga California printed: depth, bottom width 48, bottom-flange edge 15, bottom overhang 15, web 18 (extension lines at the top align with the web faces) and top-flange edge 8.

ESTIMATE (California): top width not printed; drawn equal to the 48 cm bottom (pixel widths 43-44 px at 0.89-0.90 px/cm). Top taper and bottom taper not printed; scaled from the diagram: bottom taper 15 cm on both, top taper 17 cm (167) and 13 cm (137). Resolution is ~1.1 cm per pixel, so tapers are +/-2 cm.

Simple te: all five callouts printed (93 top, 10 flange, 97 depth, 20 stem at flange, 11 at soffit). CONVENTION: flat flange soffit, square corners; the diagram shows small fillets and slightly bevelled flange tips (not dimensioned).
Doble te (95 deep, 192 wide, 8 flange, stems 20/10) not implemented: drawn flange-down and stem positions not printed.
